limitations: Descriptive scores only: assisted execution failures prevent a valid causal comparison of GPU search effectiveness.

Most assisted agents omitted the executable or misused the wrapper, then used ordinary tools. Only A01 and A03 successfully searched through the prescribed frozen CUDA helper; A05 used a different release-binary invocation.
A09 and A10 answered about Luau despite Dream Maker tasks; A11 did not substantiate an answer and inspected CEV-Eris outside the declared three-repository corpus.
Grading is unblinded, with assisted scores fixed before the grader read baseline grades. Selected source hashes were validated; complete working trees were not frozen.
The wrapper logs rejected extra attempts separately. Full model input/output/reasoning tokens and full solve latency are unobserved.
Original B05 exceeded the execution cap due to a ledger race; a locking regression fix and fresh B05R replace that trial. Unbudgeted pilots and failed coordinator launch attempts are excluded.
